entities.summary: Jibrail Kassab was a bishop of the Chaldean Catholic Church who presided over the Eparchy of Saint Thomas the Apostle of Sydney in Australia. He was the bishop of this diocese since its inception on 21 October 2006 until his retirement in 2015. His bishopric was based at St Thomas the Apostle Chaldean Catholic Church, Bossley Park, New South Wales.
